les: Die sewe kontinente en die water tussenin
kaps_punt: 'n Aardbol en kaart van die wêreld — Kontinente, hul name en waar dit op 'n aardbol en op 'n kaart van die wêreld voorkom; Oseane, die Stille (Pasifiese), Atlantiese en Indiese; Suid-Afrika, 'n land op die kontinent van Afrika (ligging)

items.bewering: Jy sien groot gebiede land en groot gebiede water.
items.blok: Land en water op die aardbol
items.bron: Smithsonian Ocean Portal, 'Just How Big Is the Ocean?' (https://ocean.si.edu/planet-ocean/seafloor/just-how-big-ocean): the ocean covers about 71% of the surface and land the rest.

items.bewering: Ons verdeel die aarde se land in sewe baie groot dele, en elke deel is 'n kontinent.
items.blok: Land en water op die aardbol
items.bron: DBE, KABV Sosiale Wetenskappe Gr 4-6 (Afrikaans), Gr 5 Kwartaal 1: 'Die sewe kontinente (oorsig van Graad 4)' (https://www.education.gov.za/Portals/0/CD/National%20Curriculum%20Statements%20and%20Vocational/CAPS%20IP%20%20AFR%20%20SOCIAL%20SCIENCES%20WEB.pdf, p. 25). The seven-continent model is a convention, and the sentence presents it as one ('Ons verdeel'), so it does not claim that Europe and Asia are physically separate pieces of land.

items.bewering: Die baie groot waterruimtes om die kontinente is die oseane.
items.blok: Land en water op die aardbol
items.bron: NOAA National Ocean Service, 'How many oceans are there?' (https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/howmanyoceans.html): the body of water covering 71% of the Earth is one global ocean, divided into named oceans.

items.bewering: Die oseane bedek saam die grootste deel van die aarde.
items.blok: Land en water op die aardbol
items.bron: NOAA National Ocean Service and Smithsonian Ocean Portal (https://ocean.si.edu/planet-ocean/seafloor/just-how-big-ocean): about 71% of Earth's surface. 'Bedek' makes it a claim about the surface, which is right; it does not read as a claim about the planet's volume.

items.bewering: Lys: Afrika, Asië, Europa, Noord-Amerika, Suid-Amerika, Antarktika, Australië
items.bron: These are the seven continents of the standard seven-continent model used in South African schools, per the DBE KABV Gr 4-6 (Gr 5 Kwartaal 1, 'Die sewe kontinente') and Britannica's continent entries. All seven names are spelled in standard Afrikaans form.

items.bewering: Antarktika lê by die suidpunt van die aarde
items.bron: Australian Antarctic Division, 'Bedrock map reveals ice-free Antarctica' (https://www.antarctica.gov.au/news/2011/bedrock-map-reveals-ice-free-antarctica/), and Geoscience Australia, Australian Antarctic Territory (https://www.ga.gov.au/scientific-topics/national-location-information/dimensions/remote-offshore-territories/australian-antarctic-territory): Antarctica is the continent around the South Pole.

items.bewering: ys bedek byna die hele kontinent
items.bron: About 98% of Antarctica is ice-covered (about 285,000 km² ice-free out of 14.2 million km², https://cove.army.gov.au/article/kyr-antarctica-information). A BAS scientist puts ice-free ground at 0.6% (https://www.rmets.org/sites/default/files/2018-11/Anna%20Jones%20-%20Work%20in%20a%20Cold%20Climate_0.pdf). Either figure supports 'byna die hele'.

items.bewering: Onder daardie dik ys lê daar egter regte land.
items.bron: Australian Antarctic Division (https://www.antarctica.gov.au/news/2011/bedrock-map-reveals-ice-free-antarctica/) and Bedmap2: there is bedrock under the ice sheet, with mountain ranges hidden beneath it. The ice averages about 1.9 km thick, which supports 'dik ys'. Much of West Antarctica's bed lies below sea level (antarcticglaciers.org, https://www.antarcticglaciers.org/?p=5749), but it is still rock and land of the continent, so 'regte land' holds. The lesson does not claim the land is all above sea level.

items.bewering: Daarom tel ons Antarktika saam met die ander ses kontinente.
items.bron: Mapping checked. The reasoning is that Antarctica's ice sits on a landmass, so the ice does not stop it being a continent. That is the standard explanation, and it agrees with the Australian Antarctic Division and Geoscience Australia material above. Taken further, it leads a learner correctly to the contrast with the Arctic, which is frozen sea and not a continent. It does not lead anywhere false.

items.bewering: Lys: Die Stille Oseaan, Die Atlantiese Oseaan, Die Indiese Oseaan, Die Arktiese Oseaan, Die Suidelike Oseaan (kop: 'Die vyf oseane')
items.bron: NOAA National Ocean Service (https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/howmanyoceans.html): the US Board on Geographic Names recognised the Southern Ocean in 1999. National Geographic adopted five oceans in June 2021 (https://www.bostonglobe.com/2021/06/11/science/how-many-oceans-are-there-earth-national-geographic-now-says-five). Five is the current widely used convention. An older four-ocean count exists, and the IHO never ratified its 2000 Southern Ocean boundaries, but that is a difference of convention, not a factual conflict. CAPS names only the first three, which the lesson includes.

items.bewering: 'n Ander naam vir die Stille Oseaan is die Pasifiese Oseaan.
items.bron: DBE, KABV Sosiale Wetenskappe Gr 4-6 (Afrikaans), Gr 4 Geografie Kwartaal 2, p. 22: 'Oseane - Stille (Pasifiese), Atlantiese en Indiese' (https://www.education.gov.za/Portals/0/CD/National%20Curriculum%20Statements%20and%20Vocational/CAPS%20IP%20%20AFR%20%20SOCIAL%20SCIENCES%20WEB.pdf). The departmental document itself gives 'Pasifiese' as the other name. Afrikaans Wikipedia uses 'Stille Oseaan' as the main name (https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stille_Oseaan), which is consistent with the lesson leading with that word.

items.bewering: Hy lê tussen Asië en Australië aan die een kant en Noord- en Suid-Amerika aan die ander kant.
items.bron: Britannica Dictionary, 'Pacific' (https://www.britannica.com/dictionary/Pacific): 'ocean separating North America and South America from Asia and Australia'. Afrikaans Wikipedia, Stille Oseaan: 'tussen Noord- en Suid-Amerika in die ooste, en Asië en Oseanië in die weste'.

items.bewering: 'n Eiland is 'n stuk land met water aan alle kante, kleiner as die kleinste kontinent.
items.bron: Britannica, 'island' (https://www.britannica.com/science/island): land smaller than a continent and surrounded by water on all sides. The smallest continent, Australia, is more than three times the size of Greenland, the largest island. The definition also leads correctly to Australia being a continent and not an island, which is where a learner would plausibly go next.

items.bewering: 'n Eiland naby 'n kontinent word gewoonlik by daardie kontinent getel, soos Madagaskar by Afrika.
items.bron: Geography of the African Union (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geography_of_the_African_Union): Madagascar is an AU member and the largest territory off the African mainland. DBE KABV Gr 5 Kwartaal 1 lists 'Madagaskar - 'n land en 'n eiland' under 'Lande van Afrika' (p. 25). 'Gewoonlik' rightly allows for exceptions such as Greenland, which is geologically North American and politically Danish.

items.bewering: Begin by Afrika want ons eie land lê op daardie kontinent.
items.bron: DBE KABV Gr 4 Kwartaal 2: 'Suid-Afrika - 'n land op die kontinent van Afrika (ligging)' (p. 22).

items.bewering: Europa lê noord van Afrika.
items.bron: Extreme points of Africa (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Extreme_points_of_Africa): Africa's northernmost mainland point is about 37°N. Europe lies roughly between 36°N and 71°N on overlapping longitudes, across the Mediterranean, so it is due north on a north-up map. That is CAPS's orientation (KABV p. 22, note **).

items.bewering: Asië lê noordoos van Afrika.
items.bron: Asia meets Africa at the Isthmus of Suez, at Africa's north-east corner, and extends north and east from there. Africa's eastern extreme is Ras Hafun, about 51°E (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Extreme_points_of_Africa), and Asia runs east to the Pacific and north to about 77°N. 'Noordoos' is correct.

items.bewering: Suid-Amerika lê wes van Afrika.
items.bron: Britannica, South America (https://www.britannica.com/EBchecked/topic/555844): bounded by the Atlantic to the east. Its latitudes (about 12°N to 56°S) overlap Africa's, and all of it lies west of Africa's westernmost point (Cap-Vert, about 17°33'W, Extreme points of Africa). It is due west across the Atlantic.

items.bewering: Australië lê oos van Afrika.
items.bron: Geoscience Australia, Continental Extremities (https://www.ga.gov.au/scientific-topics/national-location-information/dimensions/continental-extremities): mainland Australia runs from about 10°41'S to 39°08'S and from 113°E to 153°E. That is entirely east of Africa's eastern extreme (about 51°E) and in the same latitude band as southern Africa (Cape Agulhas is 34°51'S). 'Oos' rather than 'suidoos' is correct, especially as seen from South Africa.

items.bewering: Antarktika lê suid van Afrika.
items.bron: Australian Antarctic Division and Geoscience Australia, as above: Antarctica surrounds the South Pole, so it is south of every other continent, Africa included.

items.bewering: Noord-Amerika lê noordwes van Afrika.
items.bron: Britannica, North America (https://www.britannica.com/place/North-America): it lies mostly between the Tropic of Cancer and the Arctic Circle, bounded on the east by the North Atlantic. So it is north of most of Africa and west of it across the Atlantic, which makes 'noordwes' correct on a north-up world map.

items.bewering: Daar lê Suid-Afrika, aan die suidpunt van Afrika. (also 'volg die kontinent tot by sy suidpunt')
items.bron: Extreme points of Africa (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Extreme_points_of_Africa) and Cape Tourism, 'Where the two oceans meet' (https://capetourism.com/where-the-two-oceans-meet): Cape Agulhas, South Africa (34°51'S), is the southernmost point of mainland Africa.

items.bewering: Die Atlantiese Oseaan lê aan die westekant van ons land.
items.bron: Cape Tourism (https://capetourism.com/where-the-two-oceans-meet) and WorldAtlas, 'Which country has coastlines on both the Atlantic and the Indian Oceans?' (https://www.worldatlas.com/articles/which-country-has-coastlines-on-both-the-atlantic-and-the-indian-oceans.html): the west coast is Atlantic. The IHO boundary is at Cape Agulhas, about 20°E.

items.bewering: Die Indiese Oseaan lê aan die oostekant van ons land.
items.bron: Same sources: everything east of the Cape Agulhas boundary is Indian Ocean. Strictly that includes the south coast as well as the east coast. The lesson does not say otherwise, so the sentence is true as it stands.

items.bewering: Ons land grens dus aan twee van die wêreld se oseane.
items.bron: WorldAtlas (https://www.worldatlas.com/articles/which-country-has-coastlines-on-both-the-atlantic-and-the-indian-oceans.html): South Africa has coastlines on both the Atlantic and the Indian Ocean. Even its sub-Antarctic Prince Edward Islands, at about 46°S, lie north of the Southern Ocean's 60°S limit, so there is no third ocean.

items.bewering: Dieselfde twee oseane het jy al langs ons kus op 'n kaart van Suid-Afrika gesien.
items.bron: DBE KABV Gr 4 Kwartaal 2 (p. 22): the unit ''n Kaart van Suid-Afrika', which comes before ''n Aardbol en kaart van die wêreld', includes 'Name van oseane langs die kuslyn van Suid-Afrika'. Checked against the CAPS sequence only. Whether an earlier Wolkskool lesson actually showed both oceans is a question about other files and outside this check.

items.bewering: Dink terug aan die kaart van jou eie dorp en die kaart van ons land.
items.blok: Van jou eie dorp tot die hele wêreld
items.bron: DBE KABV Gr 4 Kwartaal 2 (p. 22): 'Lees van 'n kaart op 'n plaas, boeredorpie of deel van dorp' and ''n Kaart van Suid-Afrika' both come before the world-map unit. Checked against the CAPS sequence only, as above.

items.bewering: Die wêreldkaart doen dieselfde soort werk vir die hele aarde.
items.blok: Van jou eie dorp tot die hele wêreld
items.bron: Mapping checked. A town map and a world map are both flat, top-down pictures of a place that show where things lie, and that is the claim being made. The comparison does not suggest the world map is as exact as a town map. CAPS's own point that the world is round and a map is flat (KABV p. 22) is not contradicted by anything here.

items.bewering: Die wêreldkaart en die kaart van ons land staan dikwels saam in 'n boek wat ons 'n atlas noem.
items.blok: Van jou eie dorp tot die hele wêreld
items.bron: Dictionary.com/Collins, 'atlas' (https://www.dictionary.com/browse/atlas): a collection of maps, usually in book form. EBSCO Research Starter, 'Atlas' (https://www.ebsco.com/research-starters/geography-and-cartography/atlas/): it covers a country, region or the whole world. South African school atlases for Grades 4-7 (e.g. the Oxford South African Thematic Atlas listing, https://oxford.co.za/?p=31365, listing only, not opened) carry both South Africa and world maps, so 'dikwels saam' holds.

opsomming: Every checkable claim held up against sources, including the seven continents, the five oceans, the Pacific's other name (CAPS's own 'Stille (Pasifiese)'), the island definition, all six compass directions from Africa, South Africa's two oceans and the four superlatives; the only claims checked against the CAPS sequence rather than the world are the two references back to the South Africa and town maps, which the coverage check should confirm against the earlier lessons.
